objective: Test whether independently Gemini-aligned supervision improves 18-label Macro-F1 on a fixed author-disjoint human-written Dev.

split.train: All existing locked pilot Train777 plus calibration64, exactly841 rows
split.dev: The149 pre-reserved CoSoWELL authors excluded from the opened Gemini300 and all pilot-selected authors

annotationProtocol.invalidAfterFormatRetry: Exclude before model inference; never infer a reference label locally
